text: 1.Application Form for International Students of Shenyang Jianzhu University2. The original or notarized copy of the highest academic degree document (for fresh graduates, a graduation reservation certificate issued by the school must be provided), in both Chinese and English.3. Undergraduate applicants should provide the original or notarized copies of all high school course transcripts, while graduate applicants should provide the original or notarized copies of all undergraduate course transcripts in either Chinese or English.4. The first page of the passport: For overseas applicants, provide the blank page of the passport; for domestic applicants, provide all visa pages and residence permits.5.
